source: Zephyr PE QST baseline plus existing tests/s2/pe/qst automation
policy: This file is a reuse plan, not coverage proof. Existing ST2 automation must be adapted and live-validated in S1 before any official coverage promotion.

SAM-25140.notes: EPP confirmation requires a real EPP order; keep destructive guard and do not infer from Base Store.

SAM-25099.title: Order confirmation screen

SAM-25094.title: Verifiy Back to Top

SAM-25086.title: Save option for reg user

SAM-25085.title: Select saved address

SAM-25084.title: Add/Edit saved/new address on checkout page

SAM-25081.title: Checkout button on cart page
SAM-25081.notes: QST-BS-11 already adds a product, clicks checkout, and verifies checkout entry point.

SAM-25080.title: Login from Checkout page
SAM-25080.notes: Authenticated checkout exists, but current flow starts from pre-authenticated state rather than login from checkout.

SAM-25079.title: UI validation in desktop view
SAM-25079.notes: Homepage header/footer/hero exists; official Expected Result spans all pages, broken images, distortion, copyright and spacing.

SAM-25076.title: Verfiy Trade-up on cart page
SAM-25076.notes: Existing additional-services flow completes Trade-In naming path; verify whether PE UI calls official service Trade-up before binding this ID.

SAM-25075.title: Verfiy Trade-in on cart page

SAM-25074.title: SC+ on cart page

SAM-25068.title: Verify BOGO product on cart page
SAM-25068.notes: Requires a currently eligible BOGO SKU/promotion; do not hardcode stale campaign data.

SAM-25065.title: Verify rewards as a rewards user

SAM-25064.title: Order Summary on cart page

SAM-25056.title: Add/edit/delete addresses

SAM-25055.title: Login Home page
